Ia golporang bang’a manderangni segiminrangoniko see ra-gimin ong’a. Aesop’s Fables, Hans Andersen’s Fairy Stories, The Ramayana, aro gipin gipin gitchambegipa golpo- rangoniko man'aha. Mitamkode pe’anirango dingtangatna nanganirang bang'a je, sechenggi- pani golpo gita ong’piljaha. Modhunath G. Momin sagi golporangko pe*na a*ba- chengaha indiba Isol uko rimangani gimin ua pilak kamko chu'sokatsrangna man*jaha. A'chik mande sakgitam dak- chakahani gimin matchotatna man'aha.
